payload.reason: The evidence clearly indicates that the proposed multimodal NER model incorporates both text and images for named entity recognition, demonstrating its capability to learn from both modalities.

claims.text: The multimodal NER model learns from both text and images, effectively combining visual and textual information for named entity recognition.
The modality attention module in the NER model selectively amplifies relevant visual contexts while integrating textual information, enhancing entity recognition.
